remarks:
THE ONE WITH THE UPDATES. THE GARAGE. THE YARD. THE PEACE OF MIND.

If you’ve been searching for a home that offers more than just four walls, this is the one to see! This beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath Cape Cod sits on a generous 0.35-acre lot and delivers the combination buyers rarely find... move-in-ready living, updated mechanics, incredible outdoor space, and an Amish-built garage that is truly a standout.

Step inside to a bright, welcoming interior featuring fresh paint, luxury vinyl plank flooring, updated lighting and more! The spacious eat-in kitchen is equipped with new LG stainless steel appliances that opens through sliding glass doors to the expansive backyard. Whether you're hosting summer gatherings, enjoying your morning coffee, or simply looking for room to spread out, this property gives you the space to enjoy it. Downstairs, the partially finished basement adds valuable flex space along with laundry and a workbench—perfect for a rec room, home gym, hobby area, or additional storage.

Then there's the garage.The impressive 30' x 20' Amish-built detached garage is a dream for car enthusiasts, hobbyists, contractors, or anyone who simply wants room to store everything. Featuring a concrete floor, wood-burning stove, and 110V & 220V electrical service, this isn't your average garage. A matching 13' x 16' wired storage shed adds even more functionality.
    
And when it comes to major updates, this home delivers peace of mind where it counts:
Amish-installed metal roof (2025),Lennox C/A (2021), Whole-house Generac generator (2021)
Hot water tank (2023), Furnace with humidifier, Updated electrical, Gutter guards, Sump pump & drain tile system, Bulkhead basement doors, Glass-block basement window.
    
The bottom line? This is a home that has been thoughtfully maintained, meaning you can spend less time worrying about what's next and more time enjoying where you live.
 
A fantastic West Seneca location, a spacious lot, an exceptional garage, impressive storage, and updates that provide confidence. 139 Allendale Road is the kind of property buyers don't want to scroll past.
Come see why this one is different.
